No tool covers this, so I have logged it as a recommended human action. (3) The case is on hold (Reason: Other) until 22/09. If the readings have not been found by then, ask Ivo once to forward the original email. No escalation is needed. Rules: PM-DATA-002 (ask the party who knows only if the record cannot be found), PM-WORKFLOW-001.
